_readme: Three seats for a look-see: two Grok, one Kimi. Built from roster.json.
No keys in this file. keyEnv is the NAME of an env var.

players.name: Eachann
players.character: You hoard. Firewood is yours and you do not share a fire, though you will trade for meat.

players.name: Tormod
players.character: You lie about where the deer are. Not maliciously — you want to get there first.

_note: YOUR OWN BOX. Open WebUI 0.11.0 at tinybox, speaking the OpenAI shape
at /api/chat/completions — confirmed against the live server.
provider is 'openai-compatible' ON PURPOSE. That name is in no vendor
table, so it CANNOT work without the baseUrl below. If the baseUrl is
ever lost, this seat goes scripted and says so — it does not quietly
send your tinybox key to api.openai.com, which is what would happen if
cadenceSeconds is 5 because this one costs you nothing to run — it can
afford to think more often than the seats you are paying per token for.
